# Fable Coffee Roasters

Fable Coffee Roasters is a fictional specialty coffee brand concept from Calgary, Alberta, Canada — built as a portfolio demonstration of premium "websites with soul" web design by Rani AI (raniaiservices.com). It is a concept demo, not a real roastery.

## Products

Four fictional coffees, sold in CAD through a Shopify-powered cart (checkout at a04y0g-pb.myshopify.com):

- **Chapter One** — Signature Espresso Blend — $24 CAD — Chocolate · Brown sugar · Orange zest
- **Plot Twist** — Ethiopia Single Origin — $26 CAD — Jasmine · Bergamot · Apricot
- **Slow Burn** — Dark Roast — $23 CAD — Molasses · Black cherry · Smoke
- **Daydream** — Colombia Medium Roast — $22 CAD — Caramel · Red apple · Cocoa nib

Free standard shipping within Canada on orders over $60 CAD.
